title: Rental Hiring of Laser Scanning Camera for Scanning of Converter Refractory Lining in BOF-SMS
scope_summary: Tender for the rental hiring of a laser scanning camera for scanning converter refractory lining in the Basic Oxygen Furnace (BOF) and Steel Melting Shop (SMS). This is for Durgapur Steel Plant.

title: Development and Commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities
scope_summary: NALCO has issued a tender for the development and commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at its Angul Smelter Plant. The project aims to enhance industrial safety training through immersive AR/VR-based simulations, SOP-based learning, PTM simulator operations, hazard identification, emergency workflows, and performance analytics.

title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
scope_summary: Tender for a GIS-based Integrated Airport Asset Management System at Cochin International Airport, including 6 years of Annual Maintenance Contract. The project involves comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support for an integrated GIS-based asset management platform.

title: AR/VR Training Module Development

title: Implementation of APM & AIP Across Tata Power
scope_summary: Corrigendum to a tender for the implementation of Asset Performance Management (APM) and Asset Investment Planning (AIP) solutions across Tata Power. The bidder must have successfully implemented APM and AIP solutions for power utilities in at least three projects during the last five years.

scope_summary: APM Terminals Pipavav is inviting tenders for repairs of Jetty No. 1 and Approach No. 1 & 2. The tender requires a company profile, customer list, financial report for the last 2 years, and experience letter in similar projects.

title: PDF CONSTRUCTION DRAWINGS TO EDITABLE AUTOCAD DWG + REVISIONS
scope_summary: A private client is seeking an experienced architectural CAD technician/draftsperson to recreate two existing sets of professional construction drawings from PDF into clean, professionally structured, and fully editable AutoCAD DWG files. The drawings relate to two phases of a commercial facility and include architectural and MEP drawings.
